### External integrations

| System | Client wiring |
| --- | --- |
| CalDAV servers (iCloud, Nextcloud, Radicale, Baïkal, SOGo, Stalwart, Cyrus, Xandikos, Fastmail, Zoho, Mailbox.org, Purelymail) | `OkHttpCalDavClient.kt` implementing `CalDavClient.kt`, injected via `CalDavClientFactory` with server-specific `CalDavQuirks.kt` and `AuthInterceptor`. |
| CardDAV servers | `OkHttpCardDavClient.kt` implementing `CardDavClient.kt`, driven by `ContactPullStrategy.kt`, `ContactPushStrategy.kt`, and `ContactSyncWorker.kt`. |
| Tasks.org ContentProvider (`org.tasks.api` v0) | `AndroidTasksOrgRepository.kt` bound to `TasksOrgRepository.kt` in `di/RepositoryModule.kt`, mapping cursors and `ContentProviderOperation` batches through `TasksOrgV0Mapper.kt` and `TasksOrgBatch.kt`. |
| Travel Routing APIs (TomTom, Stadia Maps, OSM Valhalla Demo) | `TomTomRoutingProvider.kt`, `StadiaMapsProvider.kt`, and `ValhallaDemoProvider.kt` sharing `@TravelHttp OkHttpClient` from `TravelHttpModule` (`RoutingHttp.kt`), orchestrated by `RoutingService.kt`. |
| Android `CalendarProvider` & `ContactsContract` | `AndroidCalendarProviderRepository.kt`, `AndroidContactsProviderRepository.kt`, `ContactBirthdayRepository.kt`, `ContactAnniversaryRepository.kt`, and system sync adapters in `sync/adapter/`. |
